what:
Configurable settings policy (DECIDED 2026-04-20): All settings listed in PHASE_0_1_SPEC.md (hook intensity, recall limits, injection per-layer, scope depth, etc.) must be user-configurable at launch — NO pro/free gating, NO `public: true/false` flag check, NO `pro: true/false` gate.

Implementation:
- Remove pro/public metadata from defaults.json (or ignore it in read-config.sh)
- `aide-memory config <key> <value>` must work for every listed setting
- Validate that changing each setting actually changes runtime behavior (not cosmetic)

Drop from spec: "Configurable hook intensity (Phase 2 pro feature)" framing. All configurability is free/launch.
why: User explicit decision on 2026-04-20. Spec framed configurability as Phase 2 pro feature — rejected. All settings must be exposed and functional at launch, with validation proving they actually alter behavior. Simplifies codepath (no gating logic) and aligns with open-source positioning.
